New default to implement (verbatim from the Intent): auto-review is a security control that repository content and the model cannot weaken. A project-level .holyagent/config.json cannot turn auto-review off or replace or extend its policy (only the user's own config can), a malformed config keeps it on, its settings are fixed for the session, and it applies whenever the active model is served by the Codex provider.
